channel.title: The Motley Fool UK - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Motley Fool UK (fool.co.uk)

item.title: £10,000 invested in Meta Platforms Stock 5 years ago is now worth...
item.description: Meta Platforms has been throwing good money after bad at Reality Labs since 2021, but the stock has more than doubled. Is there a lesson for investors in there?

item.title: An 8.4% forecast yield but down 16%! Time for me to buy more of this FTSE 100 passive income star?
item.description: This FTSE 100 passive‑income machine is delivering rising payouts and strong forecasts, and its share price suggests the market hasn’t caught on yet.

item.title: Shell’s £33+ share price is near an all-time high, so why am I going to buy more as soon as possible?
item.description: Shell's strong cash generation and improving growth drivers contrast with a share price well below my valuation, suggesting major long‑term potential.

item.title: Aviva’s share price is down 13% to under £7, despite outstanding 2025 results! Time for me to buy more?
item.description: I think Aviva’s share price reflects an outdated view of the business, and that gap between perception and reality is a huge opportunity for savvy investors.

item.title: Lists of income stocks to buy almost never include this one -- but with a forecast 8.2% yield, I think they should!
item.description: This FTSE firm, not always seen as an income play, has a forecast yield of 8.2%, underlining why it's one of the most interesting dividend stocks to buy.

item.title: Why high oil prices could be good news for Lloyds shares
item.description: Jon Smith talks through the implications of elevated oil prices and translates that through to the potential impact on Lloyds' shares, along with other factors.

item.title: Down 32% and with a P/E of 9.5, is this FTSE 250 share too cheap to ignore?
item.description: This FTSE 250 share is in freefall after slashing guidance for this financial year. But Royston Wild eyes a potential dip-buying opportunity for investors.

item.title: Down 15% and a yield of 7.9%! Is this REIT dividend champion now irresistible?
item.description: This real estate investment trust (REIT) has one of the highest dividend yields on the London Stock Market. Royston Wild takes a closer look.

item.title: Stock market correction: a once-in-a-decade opportunity to get rich?
item.description: Harvey Jones examines whether investors should take advantage of the current stock market correction to buy bargain-priced FTSE 100 shares.

item.title: Down 70%, is Fevertree Drinks a share to consider buying at 815p?
item.description: Fevertree reported its 2025 earnings today and the investors liked what they saw. So is this a share to consider buying while it's still down?

item.title: Are investors taking a big gamble chasing Rolls-Royce shares higher and higher?
item.description: With Rolls-Royce shares having fallen back from their peak, the temptation to see this as a buying opportunity must be strong.

item.title: How much would someone need in an ISA to target a £1,000 monthly second income?
item.description: Christopher Ruane explains how someone could use an empty Stocks and Shares ISA to target a four-figure monthly second income within a decade.

item.title: Down 25%, are Barclays shares simply too cheap to ignore?
item.description: Barclays shares have given up a chunk of their recent gains since the Middle East powder keg ignited. Should investors pile in now?

item.title: In volatile markets, could National Grid dividends be a safe haven?
item.description: National Grid offers a dividend yield well above the FTSE 100 and aims to keep growing its payout per share. Should this writer buy the share for his ISA?

item.title: Stock market correction: a once-in-a-decade chance to build big passive income?
item.description: Ben McPoland takes a closer look at a high-yield passive income stock from the FTSE 250 that investors have been buying recently.
